text:
nina.sales: Heads up — NovaCare procurement asked for a minimal compliance packet to finish the PO: SOC2 excerpts, ISO scope note, signed pen-test attestation, a redacted staging network sketch, and confirmation of KMS tenant separation. They also want to know if Dedicated + customer KMS changes pricing. Need a short reply we can send.
carter.security: We can assemble redacted SOC2 control excerpts and the ISO scope statement. Pen-test: provide a one-page signed attestation only (no report). KMS: high-level description of key separation and HSM usage. We should clarify whether they want on-prem scanning or just a presigned upload; on-prem requires legal/ops approval.
mei.devops: For scanner access we can provision ephemeral creds and a presigned bucket path. Presigned uploads use TTL 7d and naming conv `novacare_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf`. Onprem host access needs SOW + ops time.
leo.eng: I'll prepare a redacted network diagram (no hostnames/CIDRs redacted) and a one-page KMS architecture note lifted from our encryption playbook. ETA 48h to sanitize.
nina.sales: Pricing: does Dedicated + customer-managed KMS require enterprise licensing or extra fees? Need a blurb for procurement.
carter.security: Short: Dedicated capacity + customer-managed KMS is handled as Enterprise tier (platform fee) + Dedicated commitment; there is typically a one-time integration fee for KMS work. I'll fetch ballpark uplift but advise "subject to final quote".
mei.devops: Operational impact: add ~3 business days for KMS integration and smoke tests on Dedicated. If they want a formal SOW, ops will prepare it.
legal-bot: pen-test-attestation-template.docx uploaded to evidence drive: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.docx (uploader: legal-bot).
nina.sales: Draft reply: "We can deliver a compact compliance bundle (SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope statement, signed pen-test attestation, redacted network sketch, and KMS separation note) within ~3 business days. Pen-test attestation signature may take up to 7 business days for legal sign-off. Enabling Dedicated with customer-managed KMS typically requires Enterprise tier licensing (platform fee), a Dedicated commitment (monthly/annual), and a one-time integration charge; exact pricing to be confirmed by RevOps. If you need scanning access we can provide ephemeral staging credentials and a presigned upload link (7-day TTL)." Thoughts?
carter.security: LGTM. Add: "We do not share full pen-test reports or raw internal logs; we offer attestation and remediation summaries on request."
leo.eng: I'll upload the redacted diagram to the presigned bucket when ready and ping the thread. ETA 48h.
mei.devops: Creating presigned path now; will post masked creds here once ready.
nina.sales: Thanks all — I'll send this to procurement and mark pricing provisional. Will escalate if they insist on full reports.
carter.security: Ping me if they push for report access; we'll decline and offer controlled alternatives.
mei.devops: Presigned link: https://presign.redwood/uploads/novacare_evidence/ (expires in 7d).
